items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: And the clarinet player, Louie Nelson used to work down there with us too in the district.

ctx.x: And man, she got out there with the broom and you see that man. I said, Louie, did you get them? Yeah. I said, well you had two. I went to the toilet, I stopped the toilet. See I couldn't go. Once I go in the cavalry, I had to stay in there.
And I said, Louie, did you get them?

Yeah. I said, Louie, did you get them? Yeah. I said, well you had two. I went to the toilet, I stopped the toilet. See I couldn't go. Once I go in the cavalry, I had to stay in there. Because the cops would chase me. Because I was underage, I ain't got no business down there. But my boys being a good family. You're supposed to be 21 to work there, huh? Yeah. See I could go on one side of the street, but the cops on this corner knowed me. See you had two cops here, two cops here, two cops over there, two cops over…
